title.narrative: The education system increased its capacity to deliver inclusive, skills-based education. Global best practices in digital content and blended learning modelling advanced digital education reform. Sustained municipal resources for teacher assistants, improved dropout prevention practices, and school capacity building in tolerance and conflict resolution enhanced inclusive education.
